where: 胡半仙 the fortune teller on 雍和宫 street gives it to you (chapter 4).

words.en: to be born in the year of

pages.zh: 中国人说，一年有一个动物。有十二个动物，一个一个地来。
pages.en: Chinese people say every year has an animal. There are twelve animals, and they come one after another.

pages.zh: 它们是：鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪。
pages.en: They are: rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, pig.

pages.zh: 你是哪一年来的？那一年是什么动物，你就属什么。
pages.en: Which year did you come into the world? Whatever animal that year has, that is your animal — you 属 it.

pages.zh: 二〇二三年是兔年。那一年的孩子，都属兔。
pages.en: 2023 was a rabbit year. That year's babies are all rabbits.

pages.zh: 十二年过去了，兔年再来。
pages.en: Twelve years go by, and the rabbit year comes again.

pages.zh: 大家问：“你属什么？”这是问你多大。
pages.en: People ask: “What animal are you?” It's a way of asking how old you are.

today.zh: 今天的北京：春节的时候，很多商店里都有那一年的动物。你属什么？找一找你的动物吧！
today.en: In Beijing today: at Spring Festival, that year's animal is everywhere. What's your animal? Go and find it!
